property.name: gravitino.server.webserver.host
property.description: The host of the Gravitino server.

property.name: gravitino.server.webserver.httpPort
property.description: The port on which the Gravitino server listens for incoming connections.

property.name: gravitino.server.webserver.minThreads
property.description: The minimum number of threads in the thread pool used by the Jetty webserver. minThreads is 8 if the value is less than 8.

property.name: gravitino.server.webserver.maxThreads
property.description: The maximum number of threads in the thread pool used by the Jetty webserver. maxThreads is 8 if the value is less than 8, and maxThreads must be great or equal to minThreads.

property.name: gravitino.server.webserver.threadPoolWorkQueueSize
property.description: The size of the queue in the thread pool used by the Jetty webserver.

property.name: gravitino.server.webserver.stopTimeout
property.description: Time in milliseconds to gracefully shut down the Jetty webserver.

property.name: gravitino.server.webserver.idleTimeout
property.description: The timeout in milliseconds of idle connections.

property.name: gravitino.server.shutdown.timeout
property.description: Time in milliseconds to gracefully shut down of the Gravitino webserver.
